ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote while the story still has pending tests (Pending Tests must be 0).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(copado__Pending_Tests__c)), copado__Pending_Tests__c > 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All tests on this User Story must pass before Promote.
